newsitem.title: USA: Colonial Penn to add to GE Capital earnings.
newsitem.headline: Colonial Penn to add to GE Capital earnings.

text.p: GE Capital said on Monday it expects Colonial Penn P&C Group to make an immediate contribution to the company's earnings after the acquisition is completed.
GE Capital agreed to acquire Colonial Penn P&C, a direct marketer of personal auto insurance, from Leucadia National Corp for $950 million.
Although a GE Capital spokesman said the deal will add to earnings, he said he could not provide an estimate of the size of that earnings contribution.
The deal is expected to close 1997 fourth quarter.
GE Capital, which owns major reinsurance and life insurance businesses, gains a new presence in the personal property insurance market with the acquisition of Colonial Penn.
"This is a new niche business for us," GE Capital spokesman Neal McGarity said. Therefore, the company plans to keep Colonial Penn's management team and operational platform in place.
However, Colonial Penn will become a subsidiary of GE Capital's Richmond-based Consumer Savings and Insurance Group (CSIG).
GE Capital is a wholly owned subsidiary of General Electric Co.
